title: Wringer rubric
description: A `wringer.rubric.v1` document — the acceptance criteria `wring judge` weighs a finished evidence bundle against. Source, not evidence: it lives in the repository and is committed, because its bytes travel to an endpoint. `wring plan` writes one from an approved spec's criteria block, unmodified.

title.description: What this rubric is judging. Travels in the request.

criteria.description: At most 20, at least one, and at least one of them `required` — a rubric that could only ever return 'pass' proves nothing.

id.description: A slug: it is matched against the ids in a model's reply, so it must be unambiguous.

guidance.description: How to decide it. Optional; absent and empty mean the same thing.

required.description: Defaults to true. An unmet required criterion is a `fail` verdict.

human.description: Defaults to false. When true the criterion is never sent to a judge and comes back unscored: only a person can decide it, and a model asked anyway would be guessing.
